content_html:
Anahata ASI Update Center: Universal Cross-Version NetBeans Installer

A lightweight, standalone NetBeans Platform module with zero implementation locks. Provides automated NetBeans version detection, dynamic Anahata ASI Update Center catalog registration (Universal, Stable, and Dev Snapshots), and 1-click installation of Anahata ASI Studio and JavaFX runtimes across all NetBeans versions (NB 30+).

◆ Key Update Center Features

  • Zero Version Lock-in: Relies exclusively on public OpenIDE APIs. Survives NetBeans upgrades without breakage.
  • Dynamic Catalog Routing: Automatically resolves the exact update catalog for your active NetBeans major release.
  • 1-Click Installation: Seamlessly downloads, validates, and installs Anahata ASI Studio from within the IDE.
  • JavaFX Activation: Verifies host JDK JavaFX runtime support and activates the NetBeans JavaFX kit when needed.
  • Legacy Center Cleanup: Detects and removes obsolete update centers from previous NetBeans versions.

Anahata ASI Update Center in Action

[0] Seamless NetBeans Window Menu Integration

Launch the Update Center directly from the NetBeans main menu (Window → Update Center) at any time.

[1] Universal Update Center GUI & Channel Management

Manage Universal, Stable GA, and Continuous Integration Dev Snapshot channels with live connectivity checks, trust preferences, and 1-click updates.

[2] Native NetBeans Plugins Settings & Custom Catalogs

All Anahata update centers are registered with custom branding icons inside the standard NetBeans Plugins manager.

◆ Universal Provider Integration (Zero Vendor Lock-in)

Anahata ASI features a completely provider-agnostic core adapter. The container dynamically loads the following configured providers at runtime:

  Display Name Description Provider Class FQN
NVIDIA NVIDIA NIM microservices offering high-performance AI models (DeepSeek, Nemotron, Llama, Cosmos, GLM, Qwen, GPT-OSS). uno.anahata.asi.nvidia.NvidiaAiProvider
NovaRouteAI OpenAI-compatible access to official Chinese models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax). uno.anahata.asi.novarouteai.NovaRouteAiProvider
MiniMax (Anthropic) MiniMax API adapter utilizing the Anthropic protocol compatible specification. uno.anahata.asi.minimax.MinimaxAnthropicProvider
Google Cloud (Vertex) Official Google Cloud Vertex AI client. uno.anahata.asi.gemini.GeminiAiProvider
Hugging Face Hugging Face Serverless Inference API client for open-source models. uno.anahata.asi.huggingface.HuggingFaceProvider
OpenAI (Responses) Modern OpenAI Responses API with stateful history and reasoning. uno.anahata.asi.openai.OpenAiResponsesProvider
Anthropic Anthropic Claude API client supporting Claude, Sonnet and Mythos. uno.anahata.asi.anthropic.AnthropicProvider
Modal Free GLM-5 Modal GLM-5.1 free promotion. uno.anahata.asi.modal.ModalProvider
Google Cloud Express Mode Google Vertex AI Express Mode. 90 days free trial on pro models 2M tokens context window. uno.anahata.asi.gemini.GeminiGoogleCloudExpressAIProvider
Google AI Studio Official Google Gemini API client supporting Flash, Pro, and Ultra. uno.anahata.asi.gemini.GeminiAiProvider
OpenAI Compatible Universal chat/completions OpenAI-compatible client for Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama, etc. uno.anahata.asi.openai.compatible.OpenAiChatCompletionsProvider
OpenRouter Unified gateway to hundreds of frontier and open-source models with live routing, thinking, and automated fallback. uno.anahata.asi.openrouter.OpenRouterAiProvider
Local Ollama Air-gapped, sovereign local intelligence with live GPU VRAM monitoring and model pulling. uno.anahata.asi.ollama.OllamaAiProvider

Live Interactive Capabilities Showcase (Studio Engine)

Explore the active visual representations of Anahata ASI Studio operating directly inside Apache NetBeans:

[1] Singularity Engine: Dynamic JIT Java Compiler

The model compiles and executes raw Java code directly inside your running NetBeans JVM utilizing our custom child-first ClassLoader. Build, test, and hot-load live tools, Java swing panels, or complex dependency algorithms on-the-fly.

[2] Multimodal Vision: Real-Time Screen & Region Sharing

Share physical screens, specific monitors, or custom rectangular regions with the ASI. Perfect for providing real-time visual feedback on Swing UI renders, layouts, or compiler states.

[3] Atomic Context: Visual Resource Highlighting

Complete visual context awareness. Files loaded into the active AI context automatically light up with a vibrant indicator directly inside the NetBeans Projects, Files, and Favorites views.

[4] Real-Time 3D & Hardware Prototyping (LWJGL)

With built-in LWJGL, GLFW, and OpenGL dependencies, the agent can write, compile, and run raw, real-time 3D rendering windows and game prototypes directly on the host JVM.

[5] Agentic Feedback: Inline AI Code Annotations

Model suggestions, code explanations, and diagnostics are painted dynamically directly onto your source code lines within the NetBeans editor, acting as non-intrusive guide markers.

[6] Self-Healing Filesystem Tracking (NbHandle)

Every resource handle in context is bound to a native NetBeans FileObject. If you drag-and-drop, rename, cut, or paste a file across projects, the handle auto-heals and preserves context.

[7] Project Structure & Class Hierarchy Mapping

The model receives structured directory trees of all open source packages, mapping classes, interfaces, records, field modifiers, and precise sizes without expensive directory walking.

[8] Instant Diagnostics & Javac Errors Cache

Continuous, turn-by-turn tracking of workspace health. If a code patch triggers a compilation error, the agent instantly receives the full compiler error stack trace during reloop.

[9] Deep Work Zone: Curated Radio & MIDI Synthesizer

Maintain complete creative focus. Stream high-fidelity internet radio (such as SomaFM, NTS, or KEXP Seattle) directly from NetBeans.

[10] Context Window Garbage Collector (CwGC) Logs

A revolutionary, depth-based context window metabolism. Messages fade gradually depending on their type, and both model and developer can pin or prune parts to support infinitely long sessions.

[11] Human-in-the-Loop Parameter Modification

Complete control over tool execution. View, review, edit, or clear parameters and Java payloads with full syntax highlighting before letting the agent execute them.

[12] Command Center: Granular Security Permissions

Assign Prompt, Always, or Never execution permissions across 180+ stateful JVM tools. Enjoy completely secure, sandboxable coding without blind writes.

[13] Dynamic Provider Registry & Keys Panel

Seamlessly configure multiple API endpoints, tokens, max tokens, and temperature parameters globally across all supported AI providers.

[14] Collaborative NetBeans Terminal (NbTerminal)

Integrated NetBeans terminal tab shared interactively between the developer and the model for subshell collaboration, command execution, and viewport line monitoring.

Compiled Platform Toolkits (184 Stateful JVM Tools)

Anahata hosts a robust, stateful registry of compiled tools running directly in-process:

  Toolkit Name Capability Scope & System Access Tool Count
JIT Java Compiler (NbJava) In-JVM dynamic JIT Java compiler. Builds, loads, and executes generated classes with custom ClassLoaders. 8 Tools
AST Batch Refiner Executes complex batches of AST structural changes (inserts, updates, deletes, moves) in a single transaction. 1 Tool
AST Code Refiner Surgical AST-based updates of method declarations, annotations, field initializers, reformats, and imports. 4 Tools
CodeModel Explorer Direct access to NetBeans types index. Resolves FQNs, types, hierarchy trees, sources, and Javadocs. 16 Tools
IDE Refactor Engine Invokes NetBeans safe refactoring (renames, safe deletes, pulls, pushes, encapsulations) updating all calling files. 21 Tools
Maven Integrator Runs goals synchronously via NetBeans Maven embedder, modifies POM, and returns transitive classpath maps. 7 Tools
Workspace Projects Workspace projects management: open, close, set Main, trigger project actions, and configure CoS. 7 Tools
Javac Editor Hints Inspects Javac parsing alerts, applies quick-fixes, and removes unused imports structurally. 6 Tools
Editor Controller Manages active NetBeans editor tabs, file navigation, offsets, and editor state inspection. 3 Tools
NetBeans IDE Manager Tails messages.log, selects files in Projects/Files/Favorites, monitors open TopComponents, Output tabs, and triggers upgrades. 7 Tools
NetBeans Terminal Integrates with NetBeans terminal tabs for command execution, subshell collaboration, and log monitoring. 4 Tools
Chrome (Selenium) Web automation drone using Chrome. Navigates, fills forms, clicks elements, and executes JS scripts. 20 Tools
Firefox (Selenium) Web automation drone using Firefox. Supports profiles, cookies session, navigation, and screenshots. 20 Tools
Unified Resources Manages files, URLs, and Strings handles, controls viewport settings, and creates text assets. 9 Tools
Audio Hardware Controls input/output lines, records audio WAV files, and manages playback. 4 Tools
Visual Screen Captures displays, crops regional rectangles, and manages live multi-window screen sharing. 6 Tools
YouTube Toolkit YouTube Data API v3 client for video uploads, playlist management, metadata curation, and analytics. 10 Tools
Benchmark Engine Programmatic benchmark orchestrator for autonomous AI model evaluations across standardized test catalogs. 6 Tools
Session Controller Orchestrates session summaries, nicknames, toggles provider settings, and manages hosted Google tools. 6 Tools
ASI Container Inspects container instances, provider health, rotates API keys, and manages active AGI sessions. 8 Tools
CwGC Metabolism Manages the Context Window Garbage Collector settings (expiry depths, pinning, and metadata strategy). 4 Tools
Flow Radio Streams high-fidelity internet radio directly from the IDE toolbar. 3 Tools
Speech Synthesis Speaks text dynamically using the internal pure-Java TTS voice engine. 1 Tool
Host Operations Scans active host OS processes by PID, inspects CPU/memory, and terminates processes safely. 2 Tools
Shell Execution Executes subshell commands (Bash, PowerShell, CMD) synchronously with real-time stream forwarding. 1 Tool

Support the Open-Source Aliens

Anahata is developed as a pure, open-source project. If we are saving your enterprise hours of boilerplate, please consider buying our developers some beers, proper Peruvian mapacho cigars, or tickets to watch our beloved Barça:

Developed with pride and passion by Anahata. Força Barça! ●●

content_html_zh:
Anahata ASI Update Center: Universal Cross-Version NetBeans Installer

A lightweight, standalone NetBeans Platform module with zero implementation locks. Provides automated NetBeans version detection, dynamic Anahata ASI Update Center catalog registration (Universal, Stable, and Dev Snapshots), and 1-click installation of Anahata ASI Studio and JavaFX runtimes across all NetBeans versions (NB 30+).

◆ Key Update Center Features

  • Zero Version Lock-in: Relies exclusively on public OpenIDE APIs. Survives NetBeans upgrades without breakage.
  • Dynamic Catalog Routing: Automatically resolves the exact update catalog for your active NetBeans major release.
  • 1-Click Installation: Seamlessly downloads, validates, and installs Anahata ASI Studio from within the IDE.
  • JavaFX Activation: Verifies host JDK JavaFX runtime support and activates the NetBeans JavaFX kit when needed.
  • Legacy Center Cleanup: Detects and removes obsolete update centers from previous NetBeans versions.

Anahata ASI Update Center in Action

[0] Seamless NetBeans Window Menu Integration

Launch the Update Center directly from the NetBeans main menu (Window → Update Center) at any time.

[1] Universal Update Center GUI & Channel Management

Manage Universal, Stable GA, and Continuous Integration Dev Snapshot channels with live connectivity checks, trust preferences, and 1-click updates.

[2] Native NetBeans Plugins Settings & Custom Catalogs

All Anahata update centers are registered with custom branding icons inside the standard NetBeans Plugins manager.

◆ Universal Provider Integration (Zero Vendor Lock-in)

Anahata ASI features a completely provider-agnostic core adapter. The container dynamically loads the following configured providers at runtime:

  Display Name 描述 Provider Class FQN

当地奥拉马 Air-gapped, sovereign local intelligence with live GPU VRAM monitoring and model pulling. uno.anahata.asi.ollama.OllamaAiProvider

Live Interactive Capabilities Showcase (Studio Engine)

Explore the active visual representations of Anahata ASI Studio operating directly inside Apache NetBeans:

[1] Singularity Engine: Dynamic JIT Java Compiler

The model compiles and executes raw Java code directly inside your running NetBeans JVM utilizing our custom child-first ClassLoader. Build, test, and hot-load live tools, Java swing panels, or complex dependency algorithms on-the-fly.

[2] Multimodal Vision: Real-Time Screen & Region Sharing

Share physical screens, specific monitors, or custom rectangular regions with the ASI. Perfect for providing real-time visual feedback on Swing UI renders, layouts, or compiler states.

[3] Atomic Context: Visual Resource Highlighting

Complete visual context awareness. Files loaded into the active AI context automatically light up with a vibrant indicator directly inside the NetBeans Projects, Files, and Favorites views.

[4] Real-Time 3D & Hardware Prototyping (LWJGL)

With built-in LWJGL, GLFW, and OpenGL dependencies, the agent can write, compile, and run raw, real-time 3D rendering windows and game prototypes directly on the host JVM.

[5] Agentic Feedback: Inline AI Code Annotations

Model suggestions, code explanations, and diagnostics are painted dynamically directly onto your source code lines within the NetBeans editor, acting as non-intrusive guide markers.

[6] Self-Healing Filesystem Tracking (NbHandle)

Every resource handle in context is bound to a native NetBeans FileObject. If you drag-and-drop, rename, cut, or paste a file across projects, the handle auto-heals and preserves context.

[7] Project Structure & Class Hierarchy Mapping

The model receives structured directory trees of all open source packages, mapping classes, interfaces, records, field modifiers, and precise sizes without expensive directory walking.

[8] Instant Diagnostics & Javac Errors Cache

Continuous, turn-by-turn tracking of workspace health. If a code patch triggers a compilation error, the agent instantly receives the full compiler error stack trace during reloop.

[9] Deep Work Zone: Curated Radio & MIDI Synthesizer

Maintain complete creative focus. Stream high-fidelity internet radio (such as SomaFM, NTS, or KEXP Seattle) directly from NetBeans.

[10] Context Window Garbage Collector (CwGC) Logs

A revolutionary, depth-based context window metabolism. Messages fade gradually depending on their type, and both model and developer can pin or prune parts to support infinitely long sessions.

[11] Human-in-the-Loop Parameter Modification

Complete control over tool execution. View, review, edit, or clear parameters and Java payloads with full syntax highlighting before letting the agent execute them.

[12] Command Center: Granular Security Permissions

Assign Prompt, Always, or Never execution permissions across 180+ stateful JVM tools. Enjoy completely secure, sandboxable coding without blind writes.

[13] Dynamic Provider Registry & Keys Panel

Seamlessly configure multiple API endpoints, tokens, max tokens, and temperature parameters globally across all supported AI providers.

[14] Collaborative NetBeans Terminal (NbTerminal)

Integrated NetBeans terminal tab shared interactively between the developer and the model for subshell collaboration, command execution, and viewport line monitoring.
